examples.title: Input chips
examples.html:
<m3e-form-field>
  <label slot="label" for="keywords">Keywords</label>
  <m3e-input-chip-set aria-label="Enter keywords">
    <input id="keywords" slot="input" placeholder="New keyword...">
  </m3e-input-chip-set>
</m3e-form-field>
examples.build:
M3e.FormField.build
    |> M3e.FormField.withLabel (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "keywords" ] [ Kit.text "Keywords" ])
    |> M3e.FormField.withChild
        (M3e.InputChipSet.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Enter keywords" ]
            [ M3e.InputChipSet.input
                (TypedHtml.input
                    [ Native.attribute "id" "keywords"
                    , Native.attribute "placeholder" "New keyword..."
                    ]
                    []
                )
            ]
        )
    |> M3e.FormField.toElement
